type ReadonlyStringUnion={x:number}|{readonly [key:string]:number};
function readonlyDot(value:ReadonlyStringUnion) { value.x=2; }
function readonlyBracket(value:ReadonlyStringUnion) { value["x"]=2; }
type ReadonlyNumericUnion={0:number}|{readonly [key:number]:number};
function readonlyNumber(value:ReadonlyNumericUnion) { value[0]=2; }
function readonlyNumericString(value:ReadonlyNumericUnion) { value["0"]=2; }
function readonlyDynamic(value:{[key:string]:number}|{readonly [key:string]:number},key:string) { value[key]=2; }
